derivation.definition: For x in [0,1] and u in {0,1}, select(u,x)=ReLU(x+u-1); sum one-hot-selected candidate updates.
derivation.conclusion: A fixed ReLU MLP realizes every finite state/stack transition.

derivation.premise: After T stack operations, denominator and numerator are bounded by 4^T.
derivation.conclusion: Each exact stack scalar uses O(T) bits; T polynomial in padded input length gives polynomial precision.

derivation.construction: For fixed P-complete L decidable in C n^c steps, use L_pad={w #^(C|w|^c): w in L}.
derivation.conclusion: The padding is an FO transduction, L_pad is in P and P-hard, and one recurrent step per symbol suffices.

derivation.premise: A polylog-depth circuit for the fixed P-complete RNN language would put every P language in NC by FO composition.
derivation.conclusion: If NC != P, this RNN has no O(log^k n)-depth polynomial-size simulation for any fixed k.

conditional_conclusion.consequent: The fixed P-complete RNN language is not in NC.
